description: Revert to the empirically proven "Gold Standard" configuration (Depth=8, Matrix LR=0.06, Weight Decay=0.1, Batch=128) which consistently yields the lowest val_bpb (~0.9901) and stable convergence, avoiding the instability of deeper models (OOM) or shallower models (underfitting) and the sensitivity of aggressive/conservative LR tweaks observed in previous runs.
